options.content:
One short sample. Reported data and indicative prices. Not executable and not profit.

Unchanged list rules: lowest turnover above median reported liquidity.
Measured and MinimumFeeOnly are distinct. Depth estimates ignore tick crossings; full mints have a separate column.
Within-bin is a label only and never changes R5 or selection. NotChecked is separate from rejection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id,to_char(to_timestamp((data->>'started_epoch')::bigint),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Start UTC",to_char(to_timestamp((data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "End UTC",data->>'public_requests' AS "API",data->>'rpc_calls' AS "RPC",(SELECT count(*) FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates') AS "Candidates",(SELECT count(*) FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'not_checked'='true') AS "NotChecked",'Saved + Dex' AS "Sources",CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(data->'partial_sources')=0 THEN 'None' ELSE 'Partial; see closeout' END AS "Partials" FROM research.pool_map_runs WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Reachable gap test — Modeled / Indicative

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",size_usd AS "Size $",left(pool_buy,6)||' → '||left(pool_sell,6) AS "Direction",data->>'result' AS "Result",round((data->>'modeled_dollars')::numeric,2) AS "Modeled net $",round((data->>'average_buy_price')::numeric,12) AS "Avg buy",round((data->>'average_sell_price')::numeric,12) AS "Avg sell",CASE WHEN data->>'reason' IS NULL THEN '' ELSE data->>'reason' END AS "Unknown reason",pool_buy||' → '||pool_sell AS "Full pools" FROM research.reachable_gap_results WHERE run_id='sample-20261101-20' ORDER BY data->>'symbol',pool_buy,size_usd

panels.description: 2026-11-01 CST. $100/$1,000, both pool orders, two rounds. Selected full-state round if available; exact rounds and atom fees are retained. Before transaction, priority and tip costs. Orca without tick arrays stays Indicative. Nominal USD references are price inputs only. Not an execution or profit claim.

panels.title: Meteora liquidity and fee-state labels — OnChain

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(pool_id,8) AS "Pool",(data->>'active_id')::integer AS "Active bin",CASE WHEN data->>'price_changed_across_rounds'='true' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Price changed",(data->>'last_update_age_seconds')::bigint AS "Fee-state age s",(data->>'empty_bins_to_y')::integer AS "Empty to Y",(data->>'empty_bins_to_x')::integer AS "Empty to X",(data->>'slot')::bigint AS "Slot",pool_id AS "Full pool" FROM research.reachable_gap_pools WHERE run_id='sample-20261101-20' ORDER BY pool_id

panels.description: Offset 56 is variable-parameter update time, not an independent last-trade timestamp. Empty distance counts bins lacking output-side reserves; unknown coverage remains Not measured. Final-round labels; both rounds retained.

targets.rawSql: WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1)), steps AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('R1',1),('R2',2),('R3',3),('R4',4),('R5',5)) s(step,n)) SELECT step,(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE (data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>=n) AND (n<=4 OR data->>'not_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true')) AS "Entering",(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE (data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>n) AND (n<4 OR data->>'not_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true')) AS "Leaving",reason AS "Rejection reason",rejected AS "Rejected",(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE step='R4' AND data->>'not_checked'='true') AS "NotChecked",(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE step='R5' AND data->>'failed_step' IS NULL AND data->>'not_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' AND data->>'reason'='Not measured') AS "Fee unknown",'Reported' AS "Evidence" FROM steps LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data->>'reason' AS reason,count(*) AS rejected FROM q WHERE data->>'failed_step'=step GROUP BY data->>'reason') rejects ON true ORDER BY n,reason

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'price_disagreement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Reported bps",round((data->>'onchain_gap_bps')::numeric,2) AS "OnChain bps",data->>'fee_kind' AS "Fee kind",round((data->>'combined_fee_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Fee bps",round((data->>'bin_step_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Bin step bps",CASE WHEN data->>'gap_within_bin_step'='true' THEN 'Yes' WHEN data->>'gap_within_bin_step'='false' THEN 'No' END AS "Within bin",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

panels.title: Candidates — depth estimates and mint checks

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'turnover')::numeric,2) AS "Turnover",round((data->>'sample_movement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Move bps",round((data->>'liquidity_imbalance')::numeric,2) AS "Imbalance",to_char((data->>'deepest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Deepest $ est",data->>'deepest_venue' AS "Deep venue",to_char((data->>'shallowest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Shallow $ est",data->>'shallowest_venue' AS "Shallow venue",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",CASE WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == true)' THEN 'Set' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == null)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Not set' END AS "Freeze flag",CASE WHEN data->>'failed_step'='R4' THEN data->>'reason' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.safe ? (@ == false)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Pass / exemptions' END AS "Mint check",CASE WHEN data->>'failed_step' IS NULL THEN '' ELSE data->>'failed_step' END AS "First failure",CASE WHEN data->>'reason' IS NULL THEN '' ELSE data->>'reason' END AS "Review reason",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'price_disagreement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Reported bps",round((data->>'onchain_gap_bps')::numeric,2) AS "OnChain bps",data->>'fee_kind' AS "Fee kind",round((data->>'combined_fee_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Fee bps",round((data->>'bin_step_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Bin step bps",CASE WHEN data->>'gap_within_bin_step'='true' THEN 'Yes' WHEN data->>'gap_within_bin_step'='false' THEN 'No' END AS "Within bin",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Comparison' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'
